resources.string: AntiGolem provides a visible floating toolkit over the Android launcher and apps after you explicitly enable this service. It can analyze accessibility-visible text from the active app, including Circle Select, and on Android 11+ it can use Circle OCR: after you explicitly draw a region, AntiGolem requests a screenshot through the accessibility service, crops only the selected region and performs bundled on-device Latin-script OCR. The toolkit also opens documents, manual analysis, Local AI and the full workbench. Capture and screenshots run only after an explicit toolkit action; there is no background harvesting. Protected/secure windows cannot be screenshot-scanned.
